free_tier.stated: 'MaxDebrid premium link generator is cost free' and '100% unlimited download speed', with the cap in the FAQ: 'You can generate upto 8 premium links per day.'

per_object_cap.stated: 'Our leech debrid service is unrestriced. No boring file size limitations.'

retention.stated: 'Your links are removed after you finish downloading your file'

egress.terms: '100% unlimited download speed! Grab your links as fast as you can.'

interface_detail: One web form with a 'Get Premium Link' button; no API, CLI or plugin documented.
chaining: Same slot as AnyDebrid: a no-identity one-off fetch, useful only when a file exists on one of its hundred hosts and nowhere else in the stack.

limits.value: up to 8 premium links per day

limits_note: 'Over +100 cloud service providers are supported' with no list on the home page.
binding_note: The daily link count binds long before any byte cap: 8 links a day cannot carry a 1 TiB month unless every link is over 4 GB and none fails.

identity_cost.detail: No account and no email on the generator. Generated files are IP-bound: 'Generated files are linked to a single IP, only you may start download.'

reliability_note: IP-bound links plus a hard daily count mean a retry is expensive; no status page.
confidence_note: The cap, the no-account flow and the IP binding are vendor-stated and read today. No generation was attempted, so enforcement is untested.

evidence.proved: 'You can generate upto 8 premium links per day', 'Over +100 cloud service providers', 'Generated files are linked to a single IP', '100% cost free'

notes: Same template family and same 8/day cap as AnyDebrid, YouDebrid and MegaDownloader; the builds differ (51,723 bytes here against 53,436 on AnyDebrid) so one operator is likely but unproven. Count it once with that group, not as a separate provider.
